note: `webauthnResponse` is required — the registration carries the credential public key the administrator's DID is derived from.

An administrator DID that is not the did:key of an Ed25519 or P-256 key. The DID is derived from the passkey's own public key, and only those two key types name one; a did:webvh or a secp256k1 did:key here was taken from somewhere other than the credential.

No assertion. A registration under the `none` attestation format signs nothing, so without an assertion over the community's challenge nothing proves the installer holds the private key the administrator's DID names.
